interactive_activities.title: Explore institutions of government
interactive_activities.instructions: Complete an age-appropriate task focused specifically on institutions of government. Record the evidence/work and explain what it shows.

interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where roles and responsibilities is useful. Explain your reasoning and compare it with a second example.

interactive_activities.instructions: Teach evidence and reasoning to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps, using an example or demonstration.
